text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Thursday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas signed a decree on Wednesday on the eight government of Lithuania. The new cabinet consists of 12 representatives of the Homeland Union, three Christian Democrats and two representratives of the Centre Union.

- For the first time Lithiuania and Russia talked about NATO expansion and explained their positions in a bilateral meeting in Lisbon between Lithuanian president Algirdas Brazauskas and Russian Prime Minister Victor Chernomyrdin.

- The head of parliament's budget and finance committee Elvyra Kuneviciene says that state budget of 1996 is to be increased by 430 million litas because of uncollected taxes. The planned 704 million litas budget deficit has been already used up.

- Litimpeks bank's board is to elect a new chairman today since Vincas Babilius has resigned after his appointment as the new economy minister. The most likely candidate to the post is director general of Lietuvos Dujos Kestutis Sumacheris.
- Snoras Bank doubled its share capital to 20 million litas.
- On the initiative of Confederation of Industrialists employers should sign an agreement with trade unions to increase minimum salary to 400 litas.
- The unemployment rate at the beginning of December was 6.4 percent in Lithuania.

- European journalists have elected Arturas Karnisovas, forward of Barcelona, the best basketball player of Europe 1996. Last year the best basketball player of Europe was another Lithuanian -- Arvydas Sabonis, now playing for NBA Portland Trail Blazers.
